description: This file defines a framework for project templates, including classes for project initialization, template management, and file copying utilities. It includes abstract base classes and concrete implementations for various project types, handling structure generation, testing setup, and background script execution.

classes.name: ProcessingStep
classes.description: Enum for processing steps, indicating pre- and post-processing stages.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Manages template location paths based on project type.

classes.name: ProjectTemplate
classes.description: Abstract base class for project templates, providing structure for validation, generation, testing, and processing scripts.

classes.name: ProjectTemplateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating project template instances based on project type.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main orchestrator class for initializing projects, managing template registration, creation, and waiting for post-processing.

classes.name: FileSystemHelper
classes.description: Utility class with static methods for copying files and directories with variable replacements, including handling extra files and hidden files.

methods.name: get_init_info
methods.description: Returns initialization info for the current project template.

methods.name: get_run_command
methods.description: Returns the command to run the project.

methods.name: get_entry_point_url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the project's entry point.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Runs the full project initialization process, including validation, structure generation, testing setup, and post-processing.

methods.name: wait_for_post_process_completed
methods.description: Waits for post-processing to complete within a timeout.

methods.name: _run_processing_script
methods.description: Runs a processing script in the background or synchronously, managing status files and logs.
